newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela gov't to ask $1.8 bln spending credit.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela gov't to ask $1.8 bln spending credit.

text.p: The Venezuelan government will shortly ask Congress to approve unbudgeted spending requests totaling 867 billion bolivars ($1.8 billion) to finance public sector wage rises granted in February, a government official said.
"We're going to ask for one part this month and the second part in September," the head of the Central Budget Office Moraima Padron told reporters.

Padron said the total cost of wage rises would come to 1.6 trillion bolivars this year. Venezuela's Congress already approved, in mid-June, a first unbudgeted spending credit for 903 billion bolivars ($1.9 billion) to fund public sector wage increases.
Padron said the extra spending would be largely backed by tax revenues.
